contexts.text: Berries of the olive trees () = holy goods there.
Berries from which they prepare wine (in the fifth Earth).
The two olive-trees and olive berries () = celestial goods, which are of love to the Lord, and of love towards a brother and companion.

That (the Knowledges of truth and good) are destroyed, is described by grape-gleanings being left in it, as in the shaking of an olive-tree, three berries in the head of the branch, four five in the head of the fruitful one ().
